title: the next gate read cannot be a measurement: 4 post-intervention post(s) inside the 09-28 13:00 review window (need 5) while the render loop is refused
evidence: next weekly review 09-28 13:00Z; its window is [(review - 7d), review]. Post-intervention pool (photos rendered at/after 2026-09-21 23:35:00Z -- the content-mix lever, inside Growth::GateRead::INTERVENTION_AT): 7. Inside that window: 0 already published + 4 queued = 4, against MIN_COHORT_POSTS=5. Below it Growth::GateRead returns :extend ("re-read, do NOT act") regardless of the date, so the pre-registered GO/PIVOT/KILL read is deferred by arithmetic, not by waiting. Render loop: 9 refusal(s) in the last 12h, so no new post-intervention photo can enter the pool -- the cohort is fed only by renders (publication lags them by the queue depth). That is why a GPU refusal starves the STRATEGY decision and not merely a render window. Not a Tim ask: the holder is another project's live job. Self-closes when the loop stops being refused.

notes.note: 2026-09-22 22:5xZ ops-triage: machinery confirmed live on its second pass. The read it forecasts is now on the board: growth:gate[Sarah] returns gate=extend with cohort=0/5 INVALID over a 7d window of 20 posts, i.e. the current window holds ZERO post-intervention posts (the cohort that can testify about the 09-21 content-mix lever publishes 09-27..09-29), so both upcoming reads are still forecast to fall short of MIN_COHORT_POSTS=5 while the render loop is refused. Nothing to change: the pre-committed handling of a short cohort is :extend (re-read, do NOT act), the entry self-closes when renders resume, and the render loop is refused by a live operator-interactive ComfyUI session (see render-starved for the attribution, which changed this pass).

DECISION: not repairable by cadence and NOT a reason to move the gate. The content-mix lever's post-intervention pool (photos rendered at/after 09-21 23:35Z) sits at 4 of the 5 the 09-28 13:00Z read needs, and renders are refused by the launch-args gate + the 16GiB fit floor (one condition, see render-starved). The gate is PRE-REGISTERED: it reads with n=4 as not-a-measurement rather than being re-scoped to make the cohort fit, and posting itself is unaffected (20 publishable, dry_out 09-29T10:30Z). If the operator's session keeps the card through the window, the gate's honest verdict is UNVERIFIED and the pre-registered runway escalation (dry_out <= 72h) carries the decision.
